# Gurukulam

> A gurukul-style school in Surat, Gujarat, teaching Sanskrit, Gujarati,
> English, mental mathematics and classical arts alongside sanskar
> (character), since 2004. 225 students, Bal Vibhag (age 3–7) through
> Primary Vibhag to Std. 12.

Gurukulam pairs bhantar (education) with ghadtar (character-building).
Students appear for Std. 10 as per GSEB, as external candidates, since
Gurukulam is not itself a board-affiliated school.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/): Overview, founding
  story, the four pillars taught, and the two divisions.
- [About](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/about): History,
  philosophy, the 64 and 72 codes of conduct, daily life.
- [Academics](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/academics):
  Subjects taught — languages, mathematics, dharmic knowledge, vishesh gyan.
- [Life & Arts](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/life): Classical
  arts, festivals, and the rhythm of a Gurukulam day.
- [Admissions](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/admissions):
  Eligibility, the admission process, and frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/contact): Phone,
  WhatsApp, email and location.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

This site has no server of its own — it is a set of static, prerendered
pages with no tracking, no analytics, and no accounts. See
[Privacy](https://dhanyavaria827-stack.github.io/Varia/privacy) for the
plain-language account of what the site does and does not do with a
visitor's information.
